label: 12 CFR Part 1026
name: Regulation Z — Truth in Lending
summary: Closed-end mortgage disclosures, the Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure, advertising, high-cost and higher-priced mortgages, loan-originator compensation, right of rescission, periodic statements, and ability-to-repay / qualified mortgage standards.

label: 12 CFR Part 1024
name: Regulation X — RESPA
summary: Settlement-service kickbacks, affiliated business arrangements, escrow accounts, servicing transfers, error resolution, requests for information, force-placed insurance, and loss-mitigation procedures.

label: 12 CFR Part 1002
name: Regulation B — ECOA
summary: Discrimination in credit transactions, what a creditor may ask, evaluation rules, adverse-action notices, record retention, government monitoring information, and appraisal copies.

label: 12 CFR Part 1003
name: Regulation C — HMDA
summary: Which applications and loans are reported, the data fields on the loan/application register, and the annual filing.

label: 12 CFR Part 1022
name: Regulation V — FCRA
summary: Consumer-report duties that sit with mortgage creditors, including risk-based pricing notices. The statute is the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

label: 12 CFR Part 1016
name: Regulation P — GLBA privacy
summary: Privacy notices and the limits on sharing nonpublic personal information by financial institutions under the CFPB's Regulation P.

label: 12 CFR Part 1007
name: Regulation G — SAFE Act registration
summary: Registration of mortgage loan originators who are employees of depository institutions and certain subsidiaries.

label: 12 CFR Part 1008
name: Regulation H — SAFE Act state licensing
summary: The federal floor for state licensing and registration of mortgage loan originators who are not covered by Regulation G.

label: 12 CFR Part 1014
name: Regulation N — MAP Rule
summary: Mortgage Acts and Practices advertising. Commercial communications about mortgage credit terms cannot be materially misleading.

label: 15 USC 1601 et seq.
name: Truth in Lending Act
summary: The statute behind Regulation Z, including ability-to-repay and HOEPA provisions now implemented in 12 CFR 1026.

label: 12 USC 2601 et seq.
name: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act
summary: The statute behind Regulation X, including the Section 8 prohibition on kickbacks and unearned fees.

label: 15 USC 1691 et seq.
name: Equal Credit Opportunity Act
summary: The statute prohibiting discrimination in credit transactions, implemented by Regulation B.

label: 12 USC 2801 et seq.
name: Home Mortgage Disclosure Act
summary: The statute requiring mortgage data collection and reporting, implemented by Regulation C.

label: 15 USC 1681 et seq.
name: Fair Credit Reporting Act
summary: Permissible purposes, adverse-action duties, and the accuracy framework for consumer reports.

label: 15 USC 6801 et seq.
name: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act privacy
summary: The privacy and safeguard duties for nonpublic personal information of customers.

label: 12 USC 5101 et seq.
name: SAFE Mortgage Licensing Act
summary: Licensing and registration of mortgage loan originators through NMLS, implemented in part by Regulations G and H and by state law.

label: 12 USC 4901 et seq.
name: Homeowners Protection Act
summary: Borrower-requested cancellation and automatic termination of private mortgage insurance on covered residential mortgages.

label: 12 USC 5531 and 5536
name: Unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts or practices
summary: The Dodd-Frank standards the CFPB uses against unfair, deceptive, or abusive conduct. There is no separate UDAAP part of Regulation Z.

label: 50 USC 3901 et seq.
name: Servicemembers Civil Relief Act
summary: Interest-rate relief and foreclosure protections for servicemembers. Distinct from the Military Lending Act.

label: 42 USC 4012a
name: Flood insurance purchase requirement
summary: Mandatory flood insurance in a special flood hazard area for designated loans, and the FEMA National Flood Insurance Program.

label: 42 USC 3601 et seq.
name: Fair Housing Act
summary: Discrimination prohibitions in housing and in residential real estate-related transactions, enforced primarily by HUD and the Department of Justice.

label: 31 USC 5311 / 31 CFR Chapter X
name: Bank Secrecy Act and FinCEN rules
summary: Anti-money-laundering programs, suspicious-activity reporting, and customer identification. Residential mortgage lenders and originators have a FinCEN rule at 31 CFR Part 1029.

label: 32 CFR Part 232
name: Military Lending Act
summary: Limits on certain consumer credit to covered borrowers. A residential mortgage secured by a dwelling is excluded from the MLA definition of consumer credit.

label: 12 USC 1709 / HUD 4000.1
name: FHA single-family mortgage insurance
summary: The National Housing Act insurance program and HUD's Single Family Housing Policy Handbook 4000.1.

label: 38 USC Chapter 37 / VA Pamphlet 26-7
name: VA-guaranteed home loans
summary: Eligibility, guaranty, underwriting, and refinance rules for VA loans, in the statute, 38 CFR Part 36, and the Lenders Handbook.

label: 7 CFR Part 3555
name: USDA guaranteed rural housing
summary: The Single Family Housing Guaranteed Loan Program and HB-1-3555.

label: 24 CFR Part 206
name: Home Equity Conversion Mortgage
summary: FHA-insured reverse mortgages under the National Housing Act and 24 CFR Part 206.

label: Fannie Mae Selling Guide
name: Fannie Mae Selling Guide
summary: Eligibility, underwriting, property, and mortgage-insurance rules for loans delivered to Fannie Mae, including Desktop Underwriter.

label: Freddie Mac Guide
name: Freddie Mac Seller/Servicer Guide
summary: Eligibility and servicing standards for loans sold to or serviced for Freddie Mac, including Loan Product Advisor.

label: Ginnie Mae
name: Ginnie Mae MBS
summary: The guarantor of securities backed by FHA, VA, USDA, and other government loans. Ginnie Mae is not a lender and does not set underwriting overlays.

label: FHFA loan limits
name: Conforming loan limits
summary: The Federal Housing Finance Agency publishes the baseline and high-cost-area conforming loan limits. The dollar amounts change.

label: CFPB mortgage resources
name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
summary: Official explainers, model forms, and the interactive regulations for the mortgage rules the Bureau administers.

label: 15 USC 7001
name: Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
summary: When an electronic signature or record can satisfy a writing requirement, and the consumer-consent rules that go with it.

label: NMLS
name: Nationwide Multistate Licensing System
summary: The registry used for SAFE Act licensing and registration. NMLS is the system; the SAFE Act and state law are the license rules.

label: URLA / Form 1003
name: Uniform Residential Loan Application
summary: The standard application dataset used by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. It is a form, not a disclosure under TRID.

label: 16 CFR Part 314
name: FTC Safeguards Rule
summary: Information-security program requirements for nonbank financial institutions under the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act.

label: 16 CFR Part 681
name: Identity theft red flags
summary: The identity-theft prevention program required of creditors that offer covered accounts.

label: OFAC
name: Sanctions screening
summary: Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control administers economic sanctions. Mortgage lenders screen parties against the sanctions lists.

label: Industry practice
name: File practice and market vocabulary
summary: Terms that desks use — clear to close, prior-to-doc, float-down — when no single regulation defines the phrase. The citation is the closest official source, marked industry practice.
